result.answer:
Para mag-build ng bilyahan, kailangan mo ng mga dokumento na nakalista sa Citizens' Charter. Ang mga kailangan mo ay:

1. Authority to construct mula sa lot owner [S1]
2. Notarized Special Power of Attorney (SPA) [S1, S2]
   - 1 original, 1 photocopy
3. Kung applicant ang isang corporation/association, kailangan mo ng:
   - Notarized Secretary Certificate appointing an Authorized Person (para sa residential buildings) [S2]
     - 1 original, 1 photocopy
4. Notarized Contract of Lease [S3]
   - 1 original, 1 photocopy
5. Notarized Contract of Sale [S3]
   - 1 original, 1 photocopy
6. Notarized Authority to Construct mula sa lot owner [S3]
   - 1 original, 1 photocopy
7. Notarized Special Power of Attorney (SPA) [S3]
   - 1 original, 1 photocopy
   - Applicant

Hindi lang ito lahat ng kailangan mo, kung hindi mo pa rin nakita ang Citizens' Charter ng Davao City.
